before.requirement: Release an orphan saved comment at the terminal state-machine cleanup point or during parser destruction.
before.reason: The before source has a terminal release path but no destructor release for last_comment. Neither path can receive an orphan saved comment from this zero-flag harness.

after.requirement: Release an orphan saved comment once at the terminal cleanup point or during parser destruction.
after.reason: The after source clears last_comment after terminal release and releases a remaining comment in the destructor. The fixed harness still cannot create a saved comment.

claims.reason: Both changes concern ownership of saved comments. On both source versions, the same old harness passes zero flags and has no operation that enables comment saving, so the frozen orphan-comment condition never arises.
